digest.component_or_area: LLM model class configuration and resolution
propositions: A new module model_classes.py must define and validate three capability-tier slots (frontier/standard/trivial) with model, provider, endpoint fields and optional non-recursive fallback arrays, parsing from the merged [tool.rebar.llm] config table

Each class slot must support provider omission to infer via infer_provider, matching bare-id behaviour; frontier/standard/trivial default to claude-opus-4-8/claude-sonnet-4-6/claude-haiku-4-5 respectively when unset

Environment variables REBAR_LLM_<CLASS>_<FIELD> (nine total across three classes and three fields) must override config-file values per-field without clobbering sibling fields, preserving the existing CLI > env > config > default precedence

API keys must be rejected in both class slots and fallback entries as a secrets boundary; fallback entries must forbid recursive fallback nesting and must validate to the same schema as slots minus the fallback field itself

A load_class_slots() entry point must read the model_classes sub-table from real merged config via _read_llm_file_table and return resolved class-to-provider-qualified-model mappings, inheriting graceful degradation to defaults when the table is absent
Documentation file docs/env-vars.md must be regenerated to list all nine new env vars as literal strings (not computed), and regeneration must produce byte-identical output on subsequent runs
